newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end higher in all months.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end higher in all months.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures closed higher on Monday as technical buying from local investors helped the market recover from earlier losses, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.2 to 1.0 yen higher, with benchmark November ending 0.8 yen up at 138.9 yen per kg.
Most contracts fell during the morning session, as a bearish mood carried over from last week, traders said.
The market later recovered on technical buying, they said.
"There were no strong factors to lead the market today, and technical orders dominated the market," a brokerage house trader said. -- Tokyo Commodities Desk (+81-3-3432-7391)
